key_insight: A new 11,000+ image dataset and transfer-learning models, especially VGG16, improved recognition of topological relationships between objects in images.
clinical_relevance: Better topological relationship classification can support medical imaging tasks that depend on understanding whether structures touch, overlap, contain, or remain separate.
method: Built a labeled image dataset covering key topological relations
Applied segmentation, contour detection, and grayscale normalization to derive features
Compared classical models with deep learning methods including VGG16 and InceptionResNetV2
evidence_signal: In validation testing, VGG16 achieved 89.55% accuracy and outperformed traditional machine learning models.
watch_item: Results are based on a specific curated dataset, so performance may drop when applied to different imaging modalities or real-world clinical data.
paper_title: Exploring Learning Models for Topological Relationship Recognition from Image Data
